title: Reception of an RRCReconfigurationSidelink by the UE

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationSidelink
entities.description: RRC message used to reconfigure sidelink parameters and configurations in the UE.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink
entities.description: RRC message sent by the UE to indicate successful completion of sidelink reconfiguration.

entities.name: RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink
entities.description: RRC message sent by the UE to indicate failure of sidelink reconfiguration.

entities.name: sl-ResetConfig
entities.description: Information element indicating that sidelink reset configuration procedure should be performed.

entities.name: slrb-ConfigToReleaseList
entities.description: Information element containing list of SLRB-PC5-ConfigIndex values to be released.

entities.name: slrb-ConfigToAddModList
entities.description: Information element containing list of slrb-PC5-ConfigIndex values to be added or modified.

entities.name: sl-MeasConfig
entities.description: Information element for sidelink measurement configuration.

entities.name: sl-CSI-RS-Config
entities.description: Information element for sidelink CSI-RS configuration.

entities.name: sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report
entities.description: Information element for sidelink CSI report latency bound configuration.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList-PC5
entities.description: Information element containing list of SL-RLC-ChannelID values to be released for PC5 relay.

entities.name: sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModList-PC5
entities.description: Information element containing list of sl-RLC-ChannelID-PC5 values to be added or modified for PC5 relay.

entities.name: Sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure
entities.description: Condition where UE is unable to comply with part or all of the configuration included in RRCReconfigurationSidelink.

entities.name: SL-PQFI
entities.description: Sidelink Per QoS Flow Identifier used for QoS flow mapping to sidelink DRBs.

relations.description: RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-ResetConfig IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain slrb-ConfigToReleaseList IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain slrb-ConfigToAddModList IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-MeasConfig IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-CSI-RS-Config IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-LatencyBoundCSI-Report IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-RLC-ChannelToReleaseList-PC5 IE.
RRCReconfigurationSidelink message may contain sl-RLC-ChannelToAddModList-PC5 IE.
Sidelink RRC reconfiguration failure condition triggers transmission of RRCReconfigurationFailureSidelink message.
Successful reconfiguration triggers transmission of RRCReconfigurationCompleteSidelink message.
slrb-ConfigToAddModList contains SL-PQFI values for QoS flow mapping.
